text: NInfer 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的本地推理模型提供器。它注册模型适配器、设置面板和模型管理工具，可导入本地模型、创建和调整推理配置、启动或停止引擎、进行 GPU 校准与速度测试，并导入导出便携配置。适合希望在 DSH 中运行本地 NInfer 模型并管理模型配置的用户。需要兼容的 Linux x86-64 与 NVIDIA GPU；推理服务使用本机 loopback。

NInfer adds local model inference to DSH Web. It provides a model adapter, settings panel, and management tool for importing models, editing profiles, starting engines, calibrating GPUs, and testing speed. Requires compatible Linux x86-64 and NVIDIA GPU hardware.

NInfer 的功能「本地模型配置」：在设置面板浏览文件夹并扫描 NInfer 模型，选中完整模型后创建配置，可调整名称、上下文、GPU 与推理选项，再保存或加载。
NInfer 的功能「模型运行与校准」：用户可从模型列表加载或卸载配置，也可保存设置后执行 GPU 内核校准；运行时将配置交给本机 NInfer 引擎。
NInfer 的功能「便携配置与测速」：可为模型配置导出 JSON，或导入 JSON 并在指定目录查找模型文件；速度测试使用当前配置执行并保存测速结果。

dsh-ninfer README · NInfer for DeepSeek Harness：A local NInfer model provider for DeepSeek Harness. Import a folder to find `.ninfer` models, inspect their components and missing parts, and choose a model. The model's native context is selected when its manifest declares it. Vision and MTP are enabled when present. NInfer requires an explicit draft width for MTP, so the plugin uses the upstream automatic default of three drafts.

dsh-ninfer README · Install：Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, Node 22.19+, Python 3.12+, Linux x86-64 and a compatible NVIDIA driver. In **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste `https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/dsh-ninfer` and enable it.

dsh-ninfer README · Install：On consumer Blackwell GPUs (SM120), first activation downloads the **custom engine from this repository's GitHub release**, verifies every archive part and runtime file with SHA-256, and selects it automatically. The package contains the matching server and calibration tool, CUDA and multimedia libraries, and a matching private glibc loader. No compiler, CUDA toolkit, old model folders or Desktop launcher is needed. The host supplies the NVIDIA driver. The runtime download is approximately 1.5 GiB; model weights are separate.

dsh-ninfer README · Install：This custom runtime uses upstream revision `5ed86dff9fe3a5a0776f40a7aea86cf381da990d` plus the checksum-pinned NVFP4 patch in this repository. It includes Q5_1/Q6_0 KV storage and embedding/output-head residency controls used by the recovered NVFP4 profiles. Other previously supported NVIDIA GPUs retain the pinned official NInfer release; custom-only KV controls are not advertised for that fallback.

dsh-ninfer README · Install：Progress, cancellation and retry appear in **Settings → Models → NInfer → Activity**. Existing runtimes are preserved while a verified replacement is staged. Native GPU calibration defaults to the plugin's own data directory. Models are imported separately and stay where they are.

dsh-ninfer README · Models and tuning：Choose **Import files**, open a folder and scan it. Complete models can be added; incomplete artifacts show their missing files. The plugin reads manifests and leaves weights in place. NInfer consumes `.ninfer` artifacts. A GGUF must first be converted with NInfer's tools; it is not silently converted here.

dsh-ninfer README · Models and tuning：NInfer automatically chooses resource settings and calibrates GPU kernels on first use when it has no matching device profile. **Save and calibrate** runs NInfer's native GPU calibration for the model profile. NInfer does not have Strata's Thorough model tuner; calibration is not a full model-specific optimization sweep. KV format options are NInfer's supported formats, not Strata's different K/V pairs.

dsh-ninfer README · Conversation checkpoints：**Advanced → Save conversation checkpoints** enables native disk snapshots for compatible models; it defaults on for imported Qwen3.5-family artifacts. The plugin keeps up to 16 GiB per model, evicting least recently used snapshots first. The top-level **Purge all cache** button unloads plugin-managed models and clears NInfer checkpoints while preserving profiles and weights.

dsh-ninfer README · Conversation checkpoints：Snapshot support and numerical behavior depend on the model and engine. Unsupported saves report a warning and fall back to normal prefill; the plugin does not report an unsuccessful save as a cache hit. Checkpoints contain conversation state and live under `~/.dsh/dsh-ninfer/kv` (or `$DSH_HOME/dsh-ninfer/kv`).

dsh-ninfer README · Development：`pnpm install --ignore-scripts`, `pnpm run check`, and `pnpm test`. `scripts/package-custom-engine.py` and the `custom-engine` workflow build the pinned source, verify the patched tree, and publish the relocatable runtime with checksums, source provenance and license notices. `scripts/build-checkpoint-engine.js` is the optional local build path. Automatic installation downloads the published custom binary; it does not compile on the user's computer.

dsh-ninfer README · Portable model configs：Use **Export config** beside a saved model, then **Download config JSON**. The export streams every artifact piece through MD5; large models take time and progress appears in Activity. The JSON includes context, KV format, speculation, vision and checkpoint settings, plus the exact byte size and MD5 of each required piece. Model weights are not included.

dsh-ninfer README · Portable model configs：Use **Import config**, select that JSON, and enter a model folder. The plugin searches its subfolders, checks exact size before MD5, and rebuilds the artifact’s relative shard layout using links. Renamed or relocated files can be matched. Original weights remain in place. Runtime executables, credentials and machine-specific GPU calibration are not imported; calibrate again on the destination GPU.

dsh-ninfer README · Portable model configs：Runtime downloads retry three times automatically. Bad checksums discard the damaged part before restarting it; interrupted transfers resume. A failed installation keeps a Retry button visible. Complete verified runtime folders are reused, and incomplete folders are preserved while a replacement is staged.

dsh-ninfer README · Portable model configs：Recovered configs preserve placement, host cache, graph, draft, output-limit and sampling settings. Cache-stable history uses the bundled template; imported JSON cannot choose a template path or executable. On Blackwell, the automatically installed custom engine supports recovered Q5_1/Q6_0 KV profiles; no executable selection is required. Advanced settings retain an optional executable override for other compatible builds.

dsh-ninfer README · Portable model configs：Changing Context keeps an explicit KV capacity in sync when it tracked the old context or would be too small for the new context. Automatic capacity and larger custom pools are preserved. Re-saving an older profile repairs a capacity below its selected context without changing KV precision. Startup failures show the engine's diagnostic instead of its usage manual.

dsh-ninfer README · Portable model configs：Rename a saved model under **Settings → Model name → Save**. The name is used in the model list and DSH model picker; its file paths, native model ID and tuning settings are preserved.

dsh-ninfer README · Quick speed test：In model Settings, **Test speed** sits beside **Save and calibrate**. It saves pending edits, then measures exactly 2,048 uncached prompt tokens and 512 generated tokens using the selected model, context, KV format and speculative-decoding settings. The button becomes, for example, **p144/d67**: prefill and decode tokens per second. Click it again to repeat the test.

dsh-ninfer README · Quick speed test：Rates come from NInfer's native timings and are saved per profile. Changing execution settings or recalibrating clears the previous measurement; renaming keeps it. Cancel through Activity. Failed, cached or incomplete tests preserve the last valid result. A short raw-text benchmark is not a prediction of full-context chat speed or model quality; generation ignores EOS solely to complete the fixed 512-token workload. No engine changes are required.

dsh-ninfer README · Shared GPU handoff：Install [dsh-model-scheduler](https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/dsh-model-scheduler) alongside NInfer and restart DSH. The optional service queues chat, manual loads, speed tests and GPU calibration on the selected GPU. Chat retains admission through checkpoint saving. Strata 0.6.4+ and Dory use the same interface. The card shows **Shared GPU scheduler** when attached, otherwise **Independent GPU queue**. Without the scheduler, unload other providers' models yourself before loading on the same GPU. No hard dependency is added.
